feature_name: Host Header Extractor for Axum Integration
description: Implement a host header extractor for the ak-axum package that allows route handlers to access the HTTP Host header from incoming requests. This extractor should integrate with the existing axum extractor system and provide proper error handling for missing or malformed host headers.
functional_requirements: Create a Host extractor struct that implements axum's FromRequest trait to extract the Host header from HTTP requests
Implement proper error types and conversions for cases where the Host header is missing or invalid
Register the Host extractor in the module system so it can be imported and used by route handlers
Ensure the extractor works with the existing router and tracing infrastructure without breaking existing functionality
